verdict.rationale: Runway documents per-credit pricing at $0.01 per credit, published rates (for example, draft previews bill at the 480p rate), and the ability to compare models on cost before committing to production, so cost can be judged before a run. For tracking afterwards, response metadata reports the realized credit cost, and the platform claims full visibility into cost per model, per endpoint and per team, with a usage page in the developer portal. Missing for 10: an explicit in-product per-generation cost quote shown before submitting, documented spend tracking in the creative web app (versus the developer API), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
